title: Dubai Tourist Visa Costs and Information
description: Wondering about the UAE tourist visa price and what's included? Skim through the blog to understand costs, duration, and how to apply easily!

breadcrumb.name: Dubai Tourist Visa Costs and Information

contentHtml:
The tourist visa cost Dubai is a major aspect of consideration for those who are planning to travel to the UAE. If you are going to travel to the Emirates you need to know how much you need to pay in fees. Therefore, you have to know about the cost and fees in advance.

In this article, you are going to learn how much you need to spend to process your Dubai tourist Visa. Moreover, you will learn about different types of tourist visas available for foreigners.

Dubai Tourist Visas

The Dubai tourist visa is a very important document for those who want to travel to the Emirates to enjoy everything this beautiful place has to offer. If you are a foreigner wanting to visit the UAE, you have to check first if you are exempted from a visa.

For instance, those individuals from GCC countries do not need a permit or a visa to be able to enter. On the other hand, there are individuals who have the option to apply for a visa on arrival. This can be of 30-day or 90-day.

Those that do not have the visa-free or visa-on-arrival privilege, have to apply for a pre-arranged entry permit.

In this regard, the different types of entry permits are granted for the following reasons:

  • Visit
  • Tourism
  • Transit
  • Work

As you can see, you can enter the UAE for tourism purposes. However, the Dubai visa duration will vary depending on the type you have chosen.

Apply for Your Dubai Tourist Visa Now

Visa Costs and Fees

The costs and fees of your tourist visa will depend on several factors, such as the following:

  • Duration of the visa: as you would expect, a visa that is valid for 30 days is cheaper than the one valid for 5 years.
  • Health insurance: the longer the duration of the visa, the costlier health insurance would be.
  • Additional fees: in some cases, the applicant has to pay additional fees, for instance, if the sponsored person is in the UAE.
  • Multi-entry or single entry: if you are applying to make several trips to the UAE, then the visa will be costlier.

Visa Duration and Types

In the UAE there are many different visa schemes aimed at different needs. Since the authorities are always introducing new types of visas you have to know which type of visa is the best one for you based on your needs.

The following are the types of tourist visas for foreigners:

  • Tourist visa for several entries: this document allows the holder to visit the UAE several times during its validity. However, this is a short-term visa.
  • Tourist visa for a single entry: with this visa, you can make a single visit to the UAE for tourism purposes.
  • Multi-entry tourist visa for 5 years: this is a long-term visa that allows you to travel to the UAE several times.

Since there are different types and of varied duration, the tourist visa cost Dubai will depend on the type.

Visa Requirements

Before paying the tourist visa cost Dubai, you have to gather the required documentation for your application. Make sure to read carefully the specific requirements based on your case. For instance, for a transit visa, you may need fewer requirements than for a long-term tourist visa.

In general, the requirements for applying for a tourist visa are the following:

  • Having a passport that has a six-month validity as minimum.
  • Buying a plane ticket for leaving the UAE.
  • Valid health insurance.
  • Bank balance of $4000 or its equivalent for six months before the application.
  • The applicant cannot have any restrictions for entering the UAE.

Lastly, be aware of the things you should know about validating your entry permit via stamping.

Extending Your Visa

Once you enter the UAE and you see all of its beauty, you may feel tempted to stay longer. You can do it, but you need to apply for an extension. Whether you have a tourist visa for a single entry or multiple trips, you can opt for a Dubai visa extension to prolong your stay.

The only requirement for applying for an extension is to submit your passport copy. Thus, you can extend it using any of the digital channels available or through an Amer Service Center. Just fill out your application submit it, and pay the fees.

Keep in mind that the issuing authority will decide if your visa can be extended for one or more times, as well as the duration. However, your stay cannot exceed 120 days in total.

It is worth noting that if you stay longer than the validity of your visa, without extending it, then you are subject to overstaying fines. These may depend on your particular situation, but you could end up paying 100 AED per day and 200 AED for obtaining an out pass.

Cost of 30-Day Tourist Visa (Single Entry)

The tourist visa cost Dubai for a 30-day tourist visa for a single entry is the following:

  • Issuance fee: AED 200.
  • VAT (5%)
  • No security deposit is needed.
  • The applicant has to pay additional fees if they are in the country.

As you may expect, the Dubai visit visa price 1 month is cheaper than for those with a longer duration.

Cost of 30-Day Tourist Visa (Multiple Entry)

For a multi-entry 30-day tourist visa, the cost is slightly higher than for a visa for the same duration but for a single trip.

Therefore, the tourist visa cost Dubai for this document is the following:

  • Issuance fee: AED 300.
  • VAT (5%)
  • Additional fees (if you are in the UAE): AED 500.

Cost of 60-Day Tourist Visa (Single Entry) (if applicable)

The 60 days visit visa for uae price is the same as the 30-day visa multi-entry. Therefore, you have to decide if you prefer to stay longer for the same cost or if you prefer to visit the UAE making several trips.

The following is the Dubai visit visa price 2 month for a single entry:

  • Issuance fee: AED 300.

Cost of 90-Day Tourist Visa (Single Entry)

The tourist visa cost Dubai has varied given that new visas have been launched and some of the previous schemes have been cancelled. The 90-day visa is no longer available.

Previously, the visit visa for Dubai for 3 months price was the following:

  • Issuance fee: AED 600.

Cost of 90-Day Tourist Visa (Multiple Entry)

The 90-day tourist visa was highly sought-after by foreigners as it allowed them to stay longer in the UAE. However, according to the latest news, the 3-month entry permit has been discontinued.

Nonetheless, the tourist visa cost Dubai for this type of visa for several entries was the following:

  • Issuance fee: 1740 AED.

Cost of Short-Stay Visa (e.g., 48 or 96 hours) (if applicable)

Also known as the UAE transit entry permit, this short-stay visa is aimed at those who are travelling to another place but are going to make a short stop in the Emirates. Therefore, it is a great option for those who want to get to know the place but only have two or three days available.

The tourist visa cost Dubai for this type is cheap, as it allows travellers to make a quick stop. The following is the price for this visa:

  • Issuance fee: AED 50.
  • Additionally, the person has to pay the fees for the mediator service (airlines).

Lastly, it is worth noting that there is not a Dubai visit visa price 1 week.

Cost of Extending a Dubai Visa

In case you want to extend your stay in the UAE, you have to know the steps you have to take in advance. Thus, if you want to stay longer, you already know what to do.

When you request an extension, you have to pay the following Dubai tourist visa fees:

  • Visa extension: 600 AED + 5% VAT.
  • Additional fees (if you are inside the country): AED 520.

As you can see, the cost of extending Dubai visa is considerable. Therefore, you have to include it in your budget if you plan to stay longer in the UAE.

Required Documents for Dubai Visa Application

To obtain your tourist visa and travel to the UAE, you have to look for the documentation you need to submit. Make sure to gather the documents that are required based on your particular case.

Nonetheless, the Dubai visa requirements are almost the same for all types.

Passport Requirements

Having a valid passport is the main requirement for applying for a tourist visa. It is worth noting that if you are going to apply in advance, your passport should have the specified validity.

The minimum required validity should be 6 months. This means that your passport should be valid for at least 6 months from the moment of your application. This is because if you want to stay in the UAE for 60 days, your document should be valid.

Take into consideration a special case where you may want to extend your stay for 60 more days. In this case, if your passport may expire during your stay, then most likely your application for extension may be rejected.

Proof of Onward Travel (if applicable)

Since most tourist visas are for a short term, then you have to submit your round-trip ticket to ensure you do not overstay. In the case of a transit visa, you have to submit your flight ticket that does not exceed the validity of your stay.

Hotel Booking Confirmation

Given that you are visiting the UAE for tourism purposes, it is expected for you to submit your hotel booking confirmation. With this, you can prove you have a place to stay in the UAE during the duration of your visa.

Proof of Financial Stability

Lastly, a crucial requirement for applying for a tourist visa is to submit proof of financial stability through a bank statement. Thus, this proves that you are able to support yourself economically during your stay in the UAE.

Keep in mind that there are several reasons for the rejection of your entry application, so make sure to avoid all of these mistakes.

How Long Can You Stay on a Dubai Tourist Visa?

Once you have paid the tourist visa cost Dubai visa and you obtain it, you are able to travel to the UAE and start exploring all of its wonders. However, keep in mind that you cannot overstay, as you would have to pay overstay fines in UAE, which can be quite costly.

In this regard, you have to be aware of the duration of your document so you can plan your travel. Thus, during the application process, you have to select the type of visa and its duration. In this regard, you already know how long you are able to stay.

If you are planning to extend your stay, make sure to do it in advance, as you should have your documentation up-to-date.

The duration of your stay will depend on your visa, as the following:

  • 30-day tourist visa: your stay cannot exceed 30 days from the date of entrance.
  • 60-day tourist visa: you cannot stay longer than 60 days in the UAE from the date of entrance.
  • Transit visa: your stay cannot exceed 48 or 96 hours, depending on the type.
  • Multi-entry tourist visa (5 years): you can stay for up to 90 days in the UAE on every trip, and request an extension for 90 more days.

Be aware that if you want to stay for a long term, it is best to apply for a different type of visa, such as a freelance visa in the UAE or a residency visa.

Validity of Different Visa Types

The validity of the different visa types is the following:

  • 30-day tourist visa (single entry or multi-entry)
  • 60-day tourist visa (single entry or multi-entry)
  • 5-year tourist visa (multi-entry)
  • 48-hour transit visa
  • 96-hour transit visa

Dubai Tourist Visa Fees

The visa fees are different for every type of document. However, in general, the fees are the following:

  • 30-day tourist visa: AED 200.
  • 60-day tourist visa: AED 300.
  • 30-day tourist visa (multi-entry): AED 300.
  • 60-day tourist visa (multi-entry): AED 500.
  • Transit visa: AED 50.
  • Multi-entry long-term tourist visa: AED 300 for a 30-day stay, AED 500 for a 60-day stay and AED 700 for a 90-day stay.
